metadata.title: Parity First, Arithmetic Second
metadata.description: Use odd/even rules, sign analysis, range constraints, and inequality direction without unnecessary calculation.

content.text: Odd/even questions are usually structural. Odd+odd and even+even are even; odd+even is odd; odd×odd is odd; any product with an even factor is even.

For inequalities, track sign changes carefully. Multiplying or dividing by a negative reverses an inequality. When only a range is given, test whether the conclusion is actually forced before doing algebra.
Let's use factor-pair structure to eliminate an impossible sum.
A strong exam habit is to ask: 'What is guaranteed?' That single question prevents you from treating one example as a universal rule.
